about.registryInfo: BridgeTower Capital, a Meridian Idaho based tokenization platform founded in 2020 by Cory Pugh, is the sponsor of the DOM X security token program on Avalanche. The AZX1 token is marketed as representing a claimed eleven billion United States dollar Arizona copper-gold natural resource asset within BridgeTower's broader tokenization pipeline. The technology stack uses Chainlink Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol, Chainlink Proof of Reserve, Chainlink NAVLink and Chainlink Runtime Environment oracles, with Iron by MoonPay providing fiat and stablecoin subscription rails, and Securitize acting as an SEC registered transfer agent, broker dealer, and alternative trading system partner. Backing verification failed on the following material points as of this review. The specific Arizona mining project underlying AZX1 is not publicly named, and no county, township, section, or mine operator is disclosed by BridgeTower or Chainlink. No NI 43-101 or S-K 1300 technical report has been published to support the eleven billion United States dollar claimed valuation, and no feasibility study, mineral resource estimate, or preliminary economic assessment is publicly referenced. No United States Securities and Exchange Commission Form D, Form 1-A, or Form S-1 filing has been located under BridgeTower Capital or DOM X for AZX1 despite the token being offered as securities. No private placement memorandum, offering circular, or legal opinion is published. No custodian of the underlying mining interest, auditor, or independent attestation is publicly disclosed. The token contract on Avalanche is effectively dormant with a handful of transactions from the admin address and no visible retail holders or decentralized exchange liquidity, which is inconsistent with the marketing narrative of a live eleven billion United States dollar tokenized production asset. Coverage of the project is confined to the crypto press cycle from April through July 2026 with no mainstream mining trade publication independently validating the asset. This row is Delisted and marked Suspicious pending publication of a named mine, a compliant technical report, an issuer entity, a private placement memorandum, and a US Securities and Exchange Commission filing.
